import pandas as pd

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"

    "Song of Solomon": 104000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 163000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 56000,
    "American Gods": 183000,
    "Out of the Silent Planet": 56000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 72000,
    "Brave New World": 64000,
    "Silence": 73000,
    "The Shining": 156000
}

df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
df['Word Count'] = df['Title'].map(word_counts)
df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1
# Drop rows without counts or dates
ok = df.dropna(subset=['Word Count', 'Days'])
ok['Words per Day'] = ok['Word Count'] / ok['Days']
slow = ok.loc[ok['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print(f"Slowest (words/day): {slow['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Day: {slow['Words per Day']:.2f}")
```

import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta
import holidays

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"
word_counts = {
    "Fire and Blood": 412000,
    "Song of Solomon": 104000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 163000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 56000,
    "American Gods": 183000,
    "Out of the Silent Planet": 56000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 72000,
    "Brave New World": 64000,
    "Silence": 73000,
    "The Shining": 156000
}

us_holidays = holidays.US(years=[2022])
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
df['Word Count'] = df['Title'].map(word_counts)

def count_nonholiday_days(start, end):
    day = start
    count = 0
    while day <= end:
        if day.weekday() < 5 and day not in us_holidays:
            count += 1
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    return count

# Compute non-holiday weekdays
ndays = []
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    nd = count_nonholiday_days(r['Start Date'], r['End Date'])
    ndays.append(nd)
df['NonHolidayDays'] = ndays

ok = df.dropna(subset=['Word Count', 'NonHolidayDays'])
ok['Words per NonHolidayDay'] = ok['Word Count'] / ok['NonHolidayDays']
slow_nh = ok.loc[ok['Words per NonHolidayDay'].idxmin()]
print(f"Slowest (words/non-holiday weekday): {slow_nh['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Non-Holiday Day: {slow_nh['Words per NonHolidayDay']:.2f}")
```
